text_blocks.snippet: Common and serious side effects of Jardiance (empagliflozin) are tied to how the medication helps your kidneys remove excess sugar through urine.

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Symptoms include burning, urgency, frequency, cloudy or bloody urine, and lower back or side pain.
Genital yeast infections: Vaginal yeast infections in women (thick white discharge, itching, burning) and fungal infections of the penis or scrotum in men (redness, itching, swelling, strong odor).
Increased urination: Needing to pee more often or in larger amounts.
Mild symptoms: Increased thirst, mild nausea, or joint pain.

Dehydration and low blood pressure: Can cause dizziness, lightheadedness, weakness, or fainting, especially when standing up. Risk is higher if you take water pills (diuretics), are 65 or older, have kidney disease, or follow a low-salt diet.

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A life-threatening buildup of acid and ketones in the blood—which can happen even if blood sugar is under 250 mg/dL. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach-area pain, unusual fatigue, trouble breathing, and fruity-smelling breath.

Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if Jardiance is taken alongside other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas. Symptoms include shakiness, fast heartbeat, confusion, sweating, and dizziness.
Serious kidney infections: Such as pyelonephritis or urosepsis.
Necrotizing fasciitis (Fournier's gangrene): A rare, severe, and life-threatening bacterial infection of the tissue under the skin in the perineal area (between the anus and genitals).
Lower limb amputations: An increased risk of toe or leg amputations has been observed, particularly in people with a history of amputation, peripheral vascular disease, or diabetic foot ulcers.
Severe allergic reactions: Including rash, hives, or swelling of the face, lips, tongue, and throat.

text_blocks.snippet: You can read more about safety warnings on the Jardiance Official Site.
